final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Pod listing in boutique shows a single restarting outlier: paymentservice-57b96767-95rmd with RESTARTS 2 (14s ago) while all other 10 services are at 0. Pod detail gives Last State Terminated with Reason 'Error' and Exit Code 137 (not OOMKilled), Restart Count 2. Events bind the mechanism verbatim: 'Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' (Normal Killing, x2) and 'Liveness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.1.146:50052" within 1s' (Warning Unhealthy, x7 over 81s). GetAppYAML confirms the misconfiguration: containerPort 50051, env PORT=50051, Service targetPort 50051, readinessProbe grpc port 50051 — but livenessProbe grpc port 50052, a port the container never serves. Logs confirm 'PaymentService gRPC server started on port 50051'. The liveness probe therefore can never succeed, so kubelet kills and restarts the container (exit 137), producing the abnormal-restart symptom on app/paymentservice.
